integrity: Analytical proof for all n; finite exact checker is a consistency check, not an infinite proof. No authorship or independent review is implied.
scientific_limitations: The result is a distributional coupling, not an embedding of parking-function preference lists. Its marginal formula and Borel weak limit are from Pinsky (2024), with equivalent marginal information in Diaconis--Hicks (2016); new cross-size mass inequalities and the simultaneous Markov maximal coupling are deductive advances. No independent originality certification is claimed.
title: A simultaneously maximal record-jump coupling for last-car parking deficits
